purpose: The still image processor's fusion shaders (y2s46). libredwoodair.dylib only (the two translator objects; air_metal.o is y2s45's byte for byte); Nord2Metal stays the installed y2s43 one. The Metal library inside GNR.videoprocessor has four fragment functions (FuseLumaBand_Frag, FuseChromaBand_Frag, FuseLumaTopBand_Frag, FuseChromaTopBand_Frag) that keep their textures in arrays on the stack and take them out by a number worked out at run time or by the path taken; the translator refused all four ('a store of a pointer into memory', then 'a phi between pointers that name different places'), and a processor that cannot make them cannot be made. Now: a pointer stored into a local is kept at translation time; a load from a constant place is that pointer; a load from a run-time place, and a phi of different pointers, is a choice that a texture operation answers by doing itself for each texture and selecting the results.
